meta.title: Loom local node
meta.description: An experimental Host-only node scaffold for explicitly configured isolated Loom coordinators. A temporary fixture verified actual DSH Agent sessions, scoped tools/file effects, source-linked child Agents and one zero-network text adapter. Default-off and unsupported; no token is bundled, no current Profile is changed, and this is not proof of live LLM quality, remote deployment, arbitrary Harnesses or unrestricted execution.
